'''Kevin Howard''' (also published as '''K Howard''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 Pleasanton tournament (17 February)]] on 17 February 2001 with Carbonite Chamber/IAO start, according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1739">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-18-pleasanton-ca-2-17-01d1739/ pleasanton-ca-2-17-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 18 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-18-pleasanton-ca-2-17-01d1739/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He also played at the [[July 2001 Pleasanton tournament]] on 14 July 2001 with TIEs, Wakumiu start with Maul effect, according to Kyle Ishimaru's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2641">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-15-pleasanton-7-14-01d2641/ pleasanton-7-14-01], DeckTech (Kyle "Psyokid" Ishimaru, 15 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-15-pleasanton-7-14-01d2641/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
